import os, stat, hashlib, json
paths=[
'staging/ui-music-control-prototype/verification.json',
'native/ui-music-native-adapter/native_adapter.h',
'native/ui-music-native-adapter/host_controls.c',
'native/music-continuous/runtime.c',
'native/music-continuous/runtime.h']
base='/root/garmin'
rows=[]; contents={}; total=0
for rel in paths:
    path=os.path.join(base,rel); s=os.lstat(path)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) or s.st_size>65536: raise RuntimeError('source shape/size guard')
    total+=s.st_size
    if total>65853: raise RuntimeError('declared batch guard')
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        before=os.fstat(fd); data=b''
        while len(data)<=s.st_size:
            chunk=os.read(fd,min(16384,s.st_size+1-len(data)))
            if not chunk: break
            data+=chunk
        after=os.fstat(fd)
    finally: os.close(fd)
    end=os.lstat(path)
    pin=lambda x:{'dev':str(x.st_dev),'ino':str(x.st_ino),'size':str(x.st_size),'mtime_ns':str(x.st_mtime_ns),'ctime_ns':str(x.st_ctime_ns),'mode':oct(stat.S_IMODE(x.st_mode))}
    if len(data)!=s.st_size or pin(s)!=pin(before) or pin(s)!=pin(after) or pin(s)!=pin(end): raise RuntimeError('source stability guard')
    rows.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'stat':pin(s),'fd_closed':True})
    value=data.decode('utf-8')
    contents[rel]=json.loads(value) if rel.endswith('.json') else value
print(json.dumps({'body_bytes':total,'pins':rows,'contents':contents},ensure_ascii=False))
